decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is a core-adjacent distributed product with low carrying cost, and it supports the firm's service and consumables revenue.
The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core, but as a flagship enhancement line from a key supplier partner it is likely to be kept while its sales are still building.
The sheet preparation module complements the modular system portfolio at minimal cost, though as an add-on it could quietly be replaced by a successor model.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship aligned with the firm's automation direction and has a long sales cycle, so it stays.
The hybrid saddle stitcher serves the core booklet-making business for short-run digital printers.
The folding add-on unit has documented customer installations and integrates with established Multigraf systems.
